title: Biophilic Design as an Important Bridge for Sustainable Interaction between Humans and the Environment: Based on Practice in Chinese Healthcare Space

findings.antecedent: Biophilic design
findings.mechanism: It is a space-environment design concept that can boost human health, cognition, and productivity.
findings.quote: Biophilic design... is a space-environment design concept that can boost human health, cognition, and productivity.

findings.antecedent: Real natural objects
findings.consequent: Positive effect (compared to simulated natural analogs)
findings.mechanism: research has shown that real natural objects can have a more positive effect than simulated natural analogs, and that overly distorted natural analogs can cause boredom and resentment [28].

findings.antecedent: Systematic use of several natural components
findings.consequent: Sense of natural space and environment
findings.mechanism: The combined health advantages of using several natural components in a systematic way are more important and conducive to the production of a sense of natural space and environment than the benefits of using individual natural elements alone [21].
findings.quote: The combined health advantages of using several natural components in a systematic way are more important and conducive to the production of a sense of natural space and environment

findings.antecedent: Multisensory complex stimulation of the human body by natural elements

findings.quote: The multisensory complex stimulation of the human body by natural elements is more attractive than the stimulation of a single sense.

findings.quote: Elements of nature that attract active participation and physical activity are more influential than those that only allow for static appreciation of dwelling [43].

limitations: The proposed design solutions are conceptual renderings and have not been empirically tested in real healthcare settings for their actual impact on health outcomes.
The survey measures perceived importance of biophilic design patterns rather than actual physiological or psychological responses to these designs.
The case study identifies existing problems and proposes solutions qualitatively, without quantifying the impact of these problems or the effectiveness of the proposed solutions.
